name: Landlord & the Tenants
source: You're looking after your uncle's house when he's on his journey to travel around the world. You let some girls stay at the house to earn some money. As the story progresses, you'll make them fall in love with you or train them into sluts. The game will split into 3 routes depends on your choices.
translation: 当你叔叔环游世界时，你正在照顾他的房子。你让一些女孩留在家里赚钱。随着故事的进展，你会让他们爱上你，或者把他们训练成荡妇。游戏将根据你的选择分为3条路线。
